title: Reset failure
summary: A failed reset receipt names its failure: a check row's name and ok come from the operation, never nested evidence. When the server refuses a receipt, test_machine_operation_submit_failed repeats the host's error code, reason and recovery. Sign-in refusals (test_machine_sign_in_newer_than_baseline, test_machine_sign_in_app_quit_not_proved) stop before anything is cleared.
